title: DATESMTD is the first of the month to the last selected date
query: EVALUATE CALCULATETABLE ( VAR R = DATESMTD ( 'Date'[Date] ) RETURN ROW ( "Min", MINX ( R, 'Date'[Date] ), "Max", MAXX ( R, 'Date'[Date] ), "Days", COUNTROWS ( R ), "Sales", CALCULATE ( [Sales], R ) ), 'Date'[Date] >= DATE ( 2024, 2, 5 ) && 'Date'[Date] <= DATE ( 2024, 2, 10 ) )

source.quote: Returns a set of dates in the month up to the last date visible in the filter context.
source.supports: DATESMTD goes from the first day of the month to the last visible date

derivation: The last selected date is 2024-02-10, so the result is February 1 to 10: 10 days. Sales on Feb 10: 300.
